effect: Noelle / shared native gold sword and soft profiles
scope: Static reusable geometry only. Source pose history deforms the sweep profile; it is not a baked whole-target effect.
units: 1 Blender unit = 1 meter; reference art scale 100 design pixels per unit
axes: Blender X right, Z up, -Y towards viewer; FBX -Z forward / Y up
reference: Nine separate cards with actual fronts, frames, backs and sides; all used images packed. Reference objects never exported.
vertexColor: VFXColor POINT RGBA, LINEAR export; soft edge alpha and material groups retained. Blender object alpha/reveal and authored clocks require later explicit runtime reconstruction; no Unity integration performed.
